questions.question: Which type of dam is a temporary dam constructed to exclude water from the specific area?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Coffer**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **A cofferdam is a temporary dam constructed to exclude water from a specific area**__.

 __
 
• It is designed to allow for the construction of a permanent structure in arid environments, along with damming, diversion, or dewatering.
 
• A cofferdam is constructed of a waterproof fence by depositing sheets into a bed, which is usually steel in modern works.
 
• The walls of a cofferdam must be solid and well-bonded, to withstand the shock of hitting a heavy dredging bucket; When water is pulled out of the cofferdam, they must also be able to bear horizontal forces from the surrounding body of water.
 
• Water should not be able to enter the construction site because of the dam walls.
 
• As a result, the height of the wall must exceed the excessive water level, and it must also be waterproof.
 
• Dams are preferred in large construction sites and places with sufficient depth of dry soil bed.
 
• Permanent dams, oil platforms, bridge piers, and other structures standing in or above water are regularly built or repaired along cofferdams.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **impounding reservoir** is a basin built in the valley of a stream or river to contain stream flow so that the stored water can be used when supply is in short supply.
 
• A **detention dam** is a structure designed to capture surface runoff and stream water flow in order to control the flow of water in areas below the dam.
 
• **Debris dams** are a form of detention dam that collects material to keep it from flowing into locations where a substantial deposit of debris could be harmful.

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest hydroelectric dam in the world in terms of electricity production?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Three Gorges Dam**__

The **Three Gorges Dam** is the largest hydroelectric dam in the world in** terms of electricity production.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Three Gorges Dam is a hydroelectric gravity dam that **spans the Yangtze River in Yiling District.**
 
• The Three Gorges Dam has been the **world's largest power station in terms of installed capacity (22,500 MW) since 2012.**
 
• The Three Gorges Dam has a generating **capacity of 22,500 megawatts (MW).**
 
• The height of Three Gorges is about **181 meters and the length is about 2, 335 m.**
 
• The dam creates the Three Gorges Reservoir, which has a **surface area of about 1,045 square kilometers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the **United States**, the **Grand Coulee Dam** on the **Columbia River, Washington, is the largest, with a generating capacity of about 6,800 MW.**
 
• **Tarbela Dam** is the **world’s largest fill-type dam**.
 
• It is built over the **River Indus near the small town of Tarbela in the Haripur District of Pakistan**.
 
• It is also the **second-largest dam in the world in terms of reservoir capacity.**
 
• **Longtan Dam is a large roller-compacted concrete (RCC) gravity dam on the Hongshui River in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China. **
 
• **The dam is 216.2 metres high and 849 m long.**

questions.question: In which state of India is Tawa dam located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Tawa Reservoir is a reservoir on the **Tawa River in central India**. **It is located in Itarsi of Hoshangabad District of Madhya Pradesh state**, above Betul district.
 
• The reservoir was formed by the construction of the Tawa Dam, which began in 1958 and was** completed in 1978.**
 
• The dam** provides water for irrigation in Hoshangabad and Harda districts**.
 
• The Tawa reservoir forms the **western boundary of Satpura National Park and Bori Wildlife Sanctuary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Tawa Matsya Sangh** – a federation of Fisherworker’s cooperatives – an organization fighting for the rights of the displaced forest dwellers of the Satpura forest in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The newly formed Tawa Matsya Sangh (TMS) organized rallies and a chakka jam (road blockade), demanding their right to continue fishing for their livelihood.
 
• In response to their protests, the government created a committee to assess the issue.
 
• The committee recommended that fishing rights be granted to the villagers for their livelihood.
 
• **In 1996, the Madhya Pradesh government decided to give to the people displaced by the Tawa dam the fishing rights for the reservoir.**

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest brackish water lake in Asia?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Chilika is the largest brackish water lake in Asia**__.

 __
 
• It is Asia’s largest and the world’s second-largest lagoon.
 
• It spreads over the Puri, Khurda, and Ganjam districts of Odisha on the east coast of India, at the mouth of the Daya River.
 
• It flows into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• In 1981, it was designated the first Indian wetland of international importance under the Ramsar Convention.

• **Pulicat Lagoon** is the second largest brackish water lagoon in India. It is along the Coromandel Coast.
 
• **Wular Lake **is sited in Bandipora district in Jammu and Kashmir. The lake basin was formed as a result of tectonic activity and is fed by the Jhelum River.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Kolleru Lake located?

The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

__

__
 
• **Kolleru Lake** is one of the largest freshwater lakes in India located in the state of Andhra Pradesh, 15 km from the city of Eluru.

 
 
• Kolleru is situated between the Krishna and Godavari deltas. Kolleru is spread over two districts - Krishna and West Godavari.
 
• The lake serves as a natural flood-balancing reservoir for these two rivers.
 
• **The RAMSAR site of Kolleru Sanctuary** is facing pollution and degradation due to large-scale shrimp cultivation for export.
